note: Diagnostic/preprocessing/color/PLY-write interval of production run_scan_match_debug, using one actual full-source ICP result fixed across both workflows. Source loading, normal estimation and ICP solving are excluded; frozen result/normal assignment and workflow copies are included. First-use observations trace/retain distance arrays for correctness and are excluded from performance summaries. Output hashing/checks are excluded. No outliers removed. Generated artifact paths in the new work directory are overwritten between trials. This does not measure full registration/CLI speed or change the registration algorithm, NN kernel or thread dispatch.
